note: Adapted from the description of Chatterjee and Thakur (1966) as transcribed by Chhotani (1997); the original is in English, all three castes present; the original gives the soldier postmentum length as “OJ~0-1.15” and the pronotum width as “0.63-0..70”, both lost to OCR and therefore not recorded; the density of wing microsculpture and the notation of wing length are doubtful and were also not recorded; literature citations, figure numbers and distributions omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, width about three-quarters of the length, ratio of width to length 0.71–0.81; mandibles stout, base very broad, each with a tooth situated in the middle third; postmentum rod-shaped, waist near the posterior margin, contraction index 0.56–0.70; anterior margin of the pronotum rounded without a distinct notch, posterior margin straight. Alate body with wings about 13.00–14.80 mm long, head capsule without coronal suture, distance between ocellus and eye about half its long diameter.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to brown, frons paler; mandibles brown, base paler; body white. Head and body moderately hairy. Body length about 4.0–5.40 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, width about three-quarters of the length; head length to mandibular base 1.50–1.75 mm, greatest width 1.18–1.30 mm, ratio of width to length 0.71–0.81; sides nearly parallel, posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 subequal in length to segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus elliptical, hairy, anterior margin straight; anteclypeus transparent, hairless, subtrapezoidal, anterior margin nearly straight. Labrum broad, ligulate; length 0.20–0.25 mm, width 0.31–0.40 mm. Mandibles stout, base very broad; each with a tooth situated in the middle third; length 0.75–0.80 mm, less than half the head length. Postmentum rod-shaped; greatest width 0.35–0.48 mm, waist width 0.25–0.30 mm; waist near the posterior margin, contraction index (ratio of waist width to greatest width) 0.56–0.70. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; anterior margin rounded, without a distinct notch; posterior margin straight; width slightly greater than half the head width, length 0.30–0.40 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule milky white to pale yellow, middle of the fontanelle area paler; antennae, labrum and thorax milky white. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 4.10–4.75 mm. Head subcircular, wider than long; head length to mandibular base 0.65–0.80 mm, greatest width 0.80–0.90 mm; without a V-shaped suture. Frontal plate indistinct, but with a small transparent circular spot, 0.05 mm in diameter. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus hairy, convex, width about twice the length, anterior margin nearly straight; anteclypeus semitransparent, hairless, subtrapezoidal, middle projecting forward. Labrum broad, ligulate; length 0.25–0.30 mm, width 0.33–0.40 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.23–0.28 mm, width 0.50–0.53 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown with a blackish tinge; antennae and labrum yellowish brown; postclypeus and pronotum smoky brown; wings dirty brown; ventral surface of the body pale yellow. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length with wings about 13.00–14.80 mm, without wings 8.50–9.25 mm. Head subcircular, head length to mandibular base 0.80–1.00 mm, greatest width including eyes 1.15–1.30 mm; without coronal suture. Frontal plate small, oval, maximum diameter 0.08 mm. Eyes subcircular, diameter including ocular sclerite 0.28–0.33 mm, prominent. Ocelli oval, long diameter 0.13 mm, short diameter 0.1 mm; distance to the eye about half its long diameter (0.065–0.075 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 4 and 5 subequal in length. Postclypeus convex, length slightly less than half its width; length 0.18–0.20 mm, width 0.50–0.55 mm; anteclypeus subtrapezoidal, semitransparent, middle slightly projecting forward. Pronotum flat, anterior margin slightly raised; slightly narrower than the head including eyes, length 0.60–0.65 mm, greatest width 1.00–1.13 mm; anterior margin slightly incurved with a very small median notch; posterior margin with a distinct notch. Wings transparent, colourless to dirty brown, anterior margin with 2 rows of hairs, near the posterior margin with 1–2 rows of hairs.
